# Cargo manifest of the API generated by Model2API.
[package]
name = "shop-api"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.99"
publish = false

[dependencies]
async-trait = "0.1"
axum = "0.8.9"
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
fancy-regex = "0.19"
rust_decimal = { version = "1", features = ["serde-float"] }
sea-orm = { version = "2.0.4", features = ["runtime-tokio-rustls", "sqlx-mysql", "sqlx-sqlite", "macros", "with-chrono", "with-uuid", "with-rust_decimal", "with-json"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
serde_repr = "0.1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread", "net", "sync"] }
tower-http = { version = "0.6", features = ["catch-panic"] }
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = "0.3"
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4", "serde"] }

[dev-dependencies]
tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }

[[test]]
name = "api"
path = "tests/api/main.rs"

files.README.md:
# shop-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with Axum. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires Rust 1.99 or later.

```bash
cargo run
```

Set the variables of `.env.example` in your environment first. The API listens on http://localhost:8080. Its contract is in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
cargo test
```

Each test builds the application anew, so it starts with empty storage.
The tests use a new SQLite file for each test, or the mysql database in `TEST_DATABASE_URL` (its tables are dropped before each test, and the tests take turns).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/customers` | List customers | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/customers/{id}` | Get a customer | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/customers` | Create a customer | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/customers/{id}` | Replace a customer | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/customers/{id}` | Update part of a customer | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/customers/{id}` | Delete a customer | 204 | public |
| `GET` | `/products` | List products | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/products/{id}` | Get a product | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/products` | Create a product | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/products/{id}` | Replace a product | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/products/{id}` | Update part of a product | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/products/{id}` | Delete a product | 204 | public |
| `GET` | `/orders` | List orders | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/orders/{id}` | Get an order | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/orders` | Create an order | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/orders/{id}` | Replace an order | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/orders/{id}` | Update part of an order | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/orders/{id}` | Delete an order | 204 | public |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

SeaORM on mysql. The application creates the tables that are missing when it starts, while you develop; for a real database, use migrations (Model2DB writes them). Embedded objects and lists are stored as JSON text, and references as key columns.

## Authentication

Every endpoint is public.

## Structure

```text
src/
  main.rs               entry point: reads the settings and serves the API
  lib.rs                state and router: wires storage, services and routes
  common/               errors, request bodies, lists, query strings and settings
  shared/               enums and embedded objects
  <resource>/           model, request and response, repository, service and routes of one resource
  database.rs           connection and tables
tests/api/               one test module per resource
openapi.yaml             the contract of the API
```

## Left to you

- Nothing marked: review the generated code before using it.
